name: Aloo Bhujia
ingredients_raw: Potatoes (44%), Vegetable Oil (Cotton Seed, Corn & Palmolein), Chickpeas Flour (4%), Moth bean flour(2%), Rice Powder, Starch (Sago), Salt, Coriander Powder, Cumin Powder, Mango Powder, Ginger Powder, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Lemon Powder, Red Chili Powder, Turmeric Powder, Mint Leaves Powder, Acidity regulator |Citric Acid Powder (E 330)] and Anticaking agent [Silicon dioxide (E551)]
